title: Repeat Shipment Failure Goodwill — Home Delivery Pharmacy
content:
## Member relations goodwill schedule: repeat failures

**Schedule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy missed-delivery credit, a repeat-failure goodwill amount is added by the number of the account's replacements for loss, damage or temperature (replacements for a pharmacy dispensing error are not counted) within the failure review window: 20.00 for three or more such replacements, 10.00 for exactly two, and nothing for fewer than two.

The goodwill amount is added to the credit, on top of the portion of the booked fee returned. The replacements counted are the account's replacement shipments whose reason is lost in transit, damaged or temperature excursion and whose dates fall within the failure review window.

### Goodwill by count

| Replacements for loss, damage or temperature in the window | Goodwill added |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 20.00 |
| exactly 2 | 10.00 |
| 0 or 1 | nothing |

### Counting illustrations (hypothetical accounts)

| Replacements in the window | Counted | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| one lost in transit, one damaged, one temperature excursion | 3 | 20.00 |
| one damaged, one pharmacy error | 1 | nothing |
| two lost in transit, one pharmacy error | 2 | 10.00 |
